plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): the official BSU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog 'Major in Psychological Science (BA/BS)' page for all major course codes, titles, and credits (Required 12 cr; MATH 3 cr; Individual Differences 3; Learning & Cognition 3; Diversity 3; Biological 3; Capstone 3; 6 cr 300/400-level PSYS; 6 cr 400-level PSYS = 42 cr). The catalog page render did not display the Learning & Cognition, Biological, or Capstone course tables, so those three requirements are represented as advisor-guided choice slots; an advisor must confirm the specific courses. UCC (University Core Curriculum) structure per BSU Fall 2025 advising sheets: Foundations, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 capstone (typically the major capstone; major-restricted). MATH 125 satisfies UCC Foundations math; PSYS 100 satisfies UCC Tier 1 Social Sciences; the major Capstone Experience typically satisfies UCC Tier 3 (confirm with advisor). Major 42 cr; UCC beyond major 30 cr; free electives 48 cr; total 120. SEMESTER ARRANGEMENT IS A CONSTRUCTED SAMPLE SEQUENCE - BSU does not publish an official 4-year sequence for this major; an advisor should verify the sequence. Prerequisites are not encoded beyond natural course-numbering order; see the BSU catalog for official prerequisites.
